description: This file defines the I18NTranslation class, representing a translation entity in the database for internationalization. It includes properties for language, translation string, value, and metadata including modification date, with ORM mappings and traits.

classes.name: I18NTranslation
classes.description: Entity class representing a translation for internationalization, with ORM metadata and properties for language, string, value, and metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the translation entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the translation entity.

methods.name: getLangString
methods.description: Returns the language string associated with the translation.

methods.name: setLangString
methods.description: Sets the language string associated with the translation.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language associated with the translation.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language associated with the translation.

methods.name: isCustomized
methods.description: Indicates whether the translation has been customized.

methods.name: setCustomized
methods.description: Sets the customized flag for the translation.

methods.name: getModifiedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the translation was last modified.
